rater: single rater (the research agent); judgement scores, see rationale; +-1 on any criterion is plausible

Wolfe Wave.rationale: Sources disagree on P5 (beyond line, on line, sweet zone, Fibonacci variant) and on entry; Bulkowski 47% EPA under perfect entry, rank 34/39; already implemented.

Double Top / Double Bottom.rationale: Two equal peaks, a valley, a close beyond the valley as the trigger; widely and consistently defined; the trigger is a closed-bar event. Reversal patterns were not a V1-V3 mechanism.

Head and Shoulders / Inverse.rationale: Five pivots, head higher than both shoulders, neckline break on close; clear definition; rarer than double tops and needs a sloped neckline.

Triangle (ascending, descending, symmetr.rationale: Needs line fitting with touch counts and tolerances; trendline choice changes the pattern.

Flag / Pennant.rationale: Pole size and consolidation shape vary by source; continuation after a pullback overlaps H04 (trend and pullback) of V1.

Diamond.rationale: Rare, no shared geometry, expanding then contracting range is discretionary.

Cup and Handle.rationale: Curvature has no agreed measure; long formation, rare on intraday gold.

Break-and-Retest.rationale: Overlaps H08 breakout acceptance and continuation (V2, Stage 1 failed); mostly educational sources; directly about entry timing, which is why it still scores on the weakness criterion.

Supply / Demand zone interaction.rationale: Zone construction is vendor-specific (base candles, departure strength, freshness); no shared definition.

Liquidity Sweep + Reclaim.rationale: This is H07 of Edge Program V2 (12 variants over PD and ASIA levels, reject and accept modes, Stage 1 failed). Reopening it would reopen closed research.
